name: Task Field Labels
changes: The Pro rows of the settings can now be selected without Pro. A change shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, and saves nothing. Without Pro the rows show the values in effect: default labels, normal layout, no preset and no folder rules.
tip: Labels show in Reading view. Tasks query results show them in Live Preview too.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Task Field Labels is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
